html:
The Skykomish are a Coast Salish people of the Skykomish River, in the western Cascade foothills of Washington state. They speak Lushootseed and are close to their downriver neighbours, the Snohomish and Snoqualmie.

They fished the river's salmon runs, hunted in the mountains and traded across the Cascade passes with peoples to the east. In 1855 they were among the signers of the Treaty of Point Elliott, and most moved to the Tulalip reservation, where their descendants are counted among the Tulalip Tribes.
